answer.rationale: At 94% committed volume with no buffer and only 14 days to expiry, switching primary supply based solely on a low-cost quote could introduce unvalidated delivery risk. The incumbent has demonstrated integration and delivery continuity, while prior renewals and multi-year commitments achieved meaningful price and payment improvements. Negotiate immediately against the low-cost quote, targeting the mandated 18% reduction while preserving continuity; verify the prior low-cost-vendor record before treating its quick onboarding and invoice accuracy as evidence of supply reliability.
